subject: general
question: Two pipes can fill a tank in 10 and 12 minutes respectively and a waste pipe can empty 6 gallons per minute. All the three pipes working together can fill the tank in 30 minutes. Find the capacity of the tank.
solution:
**Given:**

Time by pipe A = 10 minutes

Time by pipe B = 12 minutes

Waste pipe empties = 6 gallons per minute

Total time with all pipes = 30 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Net rate = Sum of filling rates - emptying rate

Work = Rate × Time
